name: frontend-interaction-design-plugin
description: Discovers and confirms the target frontend project and feature version, clarifies requirements, then produces reviewable interaction models and frontend development plans without generating code.

interface.shortDescription: Confirm project and version before frontend design.
interface.longDescription: Discover the target frontend project, require developer confirmation of the project and feature version directory, then check the PRD, prototype, and API contract for consequential ambiguity. Only after all three human gates pass does the strict pipeline produce user flows, frontend state models, API sequence diagrams, and an implementation-ready development plan. The plugin creates versioned design documents only and never generates or modifies application code.
defaultPrompt: Discover the target frontend project, confirm the feature version directory, and then check this PRD, prototype, and API contract.
After all three human gates pass, generate the versioned frontend interaction design package.
Create the final frontend development plan only from the confirmed project, version, and clarification decisions.
